full_judgment:
SAN Mominur Rahman J: Rule was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause why the seizure of the Mobile Telephone Sets mentioned in the show cause notice dated 11-6-2006, evidenced by Annexure-F to the writ petition, and notice dated 13-8-06, evidenced by Annexure-1 to the writ petition, should not be declared to be without lawful authority and of no legal effect and why the proceeding initiated through the show cause notice issued under section 180 of the Customs Act dated 11-6-2006 being barred by limitation should not be declared to be without lawful authority and of no legal effect and why the respondents should not be directed to release and deliver the seized Mobile Phone Sets to the petitioner without causing any damage thereto.
